answer: Withdrawing stake costs a 14% fee that is burned rather than redistributed, so moving capital between aliases destroys a slice of it every time. Because the kernel fee is applied at the horizon exit, the nectar audit totals the burn and the ledger publishes exactly what left. An operator rotating funds across many keys hence bleeds value on each hop, which is a cost an agent that leaves its stake in place never forfeits. That is 21 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
